title: Final Teleutaion Antiphon Before the Entrance
summary: A choral recording by Cappella Romana from the album Lost Voices of Hagia Sophia. It is part of a project recreating Byzantine chant using the acoustics of the Hagia Sophia.
why: Cited as an example of the Hagia Sophia acoustic recreation project, where a choir performs with the building's measured impulse response.

quote.text: Cappella Romana, a vocal ensemble choir with some researchers had tried to recreate the sounds of Hagia Sophia.
